    region,
    SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_rate)) AS total_revenue
FROM skala_orders
WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'
  AND order_date >= '2026-10-01'
  AND order_date < '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
